name: Fishkeeper — Aquarium Measurement (Demo)
description: DEMO vertical agent card for aquarium fish and water-quality measurement using Council of AI infrastructure. Not a live service. Demonstrates how a domain-specific measurement vertical would declare its A2A agent card alongside councilof.ai's measurement rails. A fishkeeper card records water-parameter observations (pH, temperature, ammonia, nitrite), fish health notes, and breeding records with evidence links, using the same card-v1 schema as every other measurement card. Measurement, not certification — no compliance grades, no aquarium rankings. The card-v1 surface for fishkeeper is pending registration; this card is a structural demo.

skills.name: fishkeeper-card
skills.description: DEMO. Produce a sample unsigned aquarium measurement card following the card-v1 schema (https://councilof.ai/schema/card-v1.json). Accepts observation data (tank id, water parameters, fish health notes, sensor readings). Returns a card structure with sha256 computed over the canonical body. The card is UNSIGNED and NOT in the public root — it is a structural demo, not a live measurement. Measurement, not certification.

demo_note: This is a structural demo of how a vertical agent card would look. No live measurement service exists behind this card. The card-v1 surface enum does not yet include a fishkeeper surface.
